label.en: Vice Director of the Secretariat / Zhongshu shilang
Vice Director of the Menxia / Menxia shilang

title.en: Sagely, Civil, Holy, Martial, and Broadly Filial Emperor

label.en: Left Vice Director / co-equal grand councilor
label.zh: 左僕射同中书门下平章事

label.en: Commissioner of the Court of Esteemed Governance
acting Minister of Works and co-equal grand councilor
label.zh: 守司徒同中書門下平章事

label.en: Zhongwu military governor / western-route campaign commander
label.zh: 忠武军节度使西路行营招讨使
护国军节度使西路行营招讨使
天雄军节度使北面行营招讨使

units.zh: 开平元年春正月壬寅，天子使御史大夫薛贻矩来劳军。
units.en: In the first month of spring, Kaiping 1 (907), on the day renyin, the Tang emperor sent Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju to visit the army and pay his respects.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, on the renyin day of the first year of Kaiping, the Son of Heaven sent Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju to come and comfort the army.

units.zh: 宰相张文蔚率百官来劝进。
units.en: Chief Councillor Zhang Wenwei led the court in pressing Quanzhong to take the throne.
units.literal: Chief Councillor Zhang Wenwei led the hundred officials to come and urge advancement.

units.zh: 夏四月壬戌，更名晃。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the day renxu, he took the taboo name Huang.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the renxu day, he changed his name to Huang.

units.zh: 甲子，皇帝即位。
units.en: On the day jiazi he ascended as emperor.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, the emperor took the throne.

units.zh: 自即位以後，大事則書，變古則書，非常則書，意有所示則書，後有所因則書。
units.en: After his accession, major events are recorded, changes to old practice are recorded, unusual events are recorded, things meant to convey a point are recorded, and things that later actions followed from are recorded.
units.literal: After the accession, major events are recorded, changes to old practice are recorded, unusual events are recorded, matters whose meaning is meant to be shown are recorded, and matters later followed from are recorded.

units.zh: 非此五者，則否。
units.en: Events outside these five categories are not recorded.
units.literal: If not these five, then they are not recorded.

units.zh: 戊辰，大赦，赦文皆曰大赦天下，此書大，見其志之欲遠及也，不曰天下，實有所不及也。
units.en: On the day wuchen there was a general amnesty. Amnesty proclamations all say "general amnesty under Heaven"; writing only "general" here shows his wish that it reach widely, while not saying "under Heaven" reflects that in fact it did not reach everywhere.
units.literal: On wuchen there was a great amnesty. Amnesty texts all say great amnesty under Heaven; here writing great shows his intent that it reach far, and not saying under Heaven shows that in fact there were places it did not reach.

units.zh: 改元，國號梁。
units.en: He adopted a new reign title and named the dynasty Liang.
units.literal: The reign title was changed, and the state was named Liang.

units.zh: 封唐主为济阴王。
units.en: The deposed Tang emperor was given the title Prince of Jiyin.
units.literal: The Tang ruler was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiyin.

units.zh: 謂天子為唐主，錄其本語如此。
units.en: This calls the Son of Heaven the Tang ruler, preserving the original wording as it stood.
units.literal: Calling the Son of Heaven the Tang ruler records the original wording in this way.

units.zh: 升汴州为开封府，建为东都，以唐东都为西都。
units.en: Bianzhou became Kaifengfu and the eastern capital; the old Tang eastern capital became the western capital.
units.literal: Bian Prefecture was elevated to Kaifeng Prefecture and made the eastern capital; the Tang eastern capital was made the western capital.

units.zh: 废京兆府为雍州。
units.en: Jingzhaofu was downgraded to Yongzhou.
units.literal: Jingzhao Prefecture was abolished and made Yong Prefecture.

units.zh: 州縣廢置，見職方考，惟京都則書。
units.en: The abolition and establishment of prefectures and counties are shown in the Treatise on Offices; only the capitals are recorded here.
units.literal: Abolition and establishment of prefectures and counties is seen in the Treatise on Offices; only capitals are recorded.

units.zh: 赐东都酺一日。
units.en: The eastern capital was granted a day of public celebration.
units.literal: The eastern capital was granted one day of communal feasting.

units.zh: 契丹阿保机使袍笏梅老来。
units.en: Abaoji of the Khitan sent an envoy, Paoju Meilao.
units.literal: Abaoji of the Khitan sent the envoy Paoju Meilao.

units.zh: 夷狄來，不言朝，不責其禮；
units.en: When Yi and Di come, the text does not say "came to court," because it does not hold them to court ritual.
units.literal: When Yi and Di come, it does not say came to court, because their ritual is not charged to them.

units.zh: 不言貢，不貴其物。
units.en: It does not say "offered tribute," because it does not dignify their goods.
units.literal: It does not say offered tribute, because their goods are not esteemed.

units.zh: 故書曰來。
units.en: Therefore it simply says "came."
units.literal: Therefore the text says came.

units.zh: 五代亂世，著其屢來，以見夷狄之來不來，不因治亂。
units.en: In the chaotic age of the Five Dynasties, recording their repeated arrivals shows that whether Yi and Di came did not depend on whether the realm was well ordered or in disorder.
units.literal: In the disorderly age of the Five Dynasties, recording their repeated arrivals shows that whether Yi and Di come or not does not depend on order or disorder.

units.zh: 而亂世屢來，不足貴也。
units.en: Repeated arrivals in a time of disorder were not worthy of honor.
units.literal: And repeated arrivals in a disorderly age are not worthy of esteem.

units.zh: 五月丁丑朔，以唐相張文蔚楊涉為門下侍郎、御史大夫薛貽矩為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。
units.en: On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, the former Tang chancellors Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were made vice directors of the Chancellery (Menxia), and Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju became vice director of the Secretariat (Zhongshu); all held the rank of co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
units.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, dingchou, the Tang chancellors Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were made vice directors of the Chancellery, and Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju vice director of the Secretariat; all were co-equal managers of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 戊寅，渤海、契丹遣使者来。
units.en: On the day wuyin, Bohai and the Khitan sent envoys.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, Bohai and the Khitan sent envoys.

units.zh: 夷狄君臣姓名、官爵，或書或否，不必備，或因其舊史之詳略，但書其來以示意爾。
units.en: For Yi and Di rulers and ministers, names and titles are sometimes recorded and sometimes not. They need not be complete; the text may simply follow the fullness or brevity of the old history, recording only their arrival to convey the point.
units.literal: For Yi and Di rulers and ministers, names and official titles are sometimes recorded and sometimes not; they need not be complete, or may follow the fullness or brevity of the old history, merely recording that they came to show the point.

units.zh: 乙酉，兄全昱為廣王，子友文博王，友文非子而書子，語在家人傳。
units.en: On the day yiyou, his brother Quanyu was made Prince of Guang and his son Youwen Prince of Bo; Youwen was not actually his son, but he is written here as "son," as explained in the Biographies of the Imperial Household.
units.literal: On yiyou, his brother Quanyu became Prince of Guang and his son Youwen Prince of Bo; Youwen was not his son, yet the text writes son, as explained in the Biographies of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 友珪郢王，友璋福王，友貞均王，友徽建王，姪友諒衡王，友能惠王，友誨邵王。
units.en: Yougui was made Prince of Ying, Youzhang Prince of Fu, Youzhen Prince of Jun, Youhui written 友徽 Prince of Jian, his nephew Youliang Prince of Heng, Youneng Prince of Hui, and Youhui written 友誨 Prince of Shao.
units.literal: Yougui became Prince of Ying, Youzhang Prince of Fu, Youzhen Prince of Jun, Youhui Prince of Jian, his nephew Youliang Prince of Heng, Youneng Prince of Hui, and Youhui Prince of Shao.

units.zh: 甲午，改樞密院為崇政院，太府卿敬翔為使。
units.en: On the day jiawu, the Privy Council was renamed the Court of Esteemed Governance, with Grand Chamberlain Jing Xiang as its commissioner.
units.literal: On jiawu, the Privy Council was changed into the Court of Esteemed Governance, and Grand Chamberlain Jing Xiang became its commissioner.

units.zh: 是月，潞州行營都指揮使李思安及晉人戰，敗績。
units.en: That month Li Si'an, commander of the Lu Prefecture campaign army, fought the Jin forces and was defeated.
units.literal: That month, Li Sian, commander of the Luzhou campaign army, fought the Jin forces and was defeated.

units.zh: 我敗曰敗績，彼敗曰敗之，文理宜然。
units.en: When our own side loses, the text says "was defeated"; when the other side loses, it says "defeated them." This distinction is proper to the logic of the wording.
units.literal: When our side loses it says was defeated; when the other side loses it says defeated them; this is proper to the logic of the wording.

units.zh: 已見行營，故戰不言地。
units.en: The campaign army has already been mentioned, so the battle is recorded without naming the place.
units.literal: The campaign army has already appeared, therefore the battle does not state the place.

units.zh: 六月甲寅，平盧軍節度使韓建守司徒，同中書門下平章事。
units.en: In the sixth month, on the day jiayin, Han Jian, military governor of Pinglu, was named acting Minister of Works and co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jiayin, Han Jian, military governor of Pinglu, acted as Minister of Works and was co-equal manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 秋七月己亥，追尊祖考为皇帝，妣为皇后；
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jihai, he posthumously honored his forebears as emperors and their consorts as empresses;
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jihai day, his ancestors and father were posthumously honored as emperors and his mother as empress;

units.zh: 皇高祖黯谥曰宣元，庙号肃祖， 祖妣范氏谥曰宣僖；
units.en: his high ancestor (gaozu) An received the posthumous name Xuan Yuan and temple name Ancestor Su, and his high ancestress of the Fan clan the name Xuanxi;
units.literal: his great-grandfather An was given the posthumous title Xuan Yuan and temple name Suzu, and his great-grandmother the Fan clan the title Xuanxi;

units.zh: 曾祖茂琳谥曰光献，庙号敬祖，祖妣杨氏谥曰光孝；
units.en: his great-grandfather Maolin the name Guang Xian and temple name Ancestor Jing, and his great-grandmother of the Yang clan the name Guang Xiao;
units.literal: his great-grandfather Maolin the title Guang Xian and temple name Jingzu, and his great-grandmother the Yang clan the title Guang Xiao;

units.zh: 祖信谥曰昭武，庙号宪祖，祖妣刘氏谥曰昭懿；
units.en: his grandfather Xin the name Zhao Wu and temple name Ancestor Xian, and his grandmother of the Liu clan the name Zhao Yi;
units.literal: his grandfather Xin the title Zhao Wu and temple name Xianzu, and his grandmother the Liu clan the title Zhao Yi;

units.zh: 考诚谥曰文穆，庙号烈祖，妣王氏谥曰文惠。
units.en: his father Cheng the name Wen Mu and temple name Ancestor Lie, and his mother of the Wang clan the name Wen Hui.
units.literal: his father Cheng the title Wen Mu and temple name Liezu, and his mother the Wang clan the title Wen Hui.

units.zh: 八月丁卯，同州虸蚄虫生。
units.en: In the eighth month, on the day dingmao, locusts hatched in Tongzhou.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the dingmao day, locusts were born in Tong Prefecture.

units.zh: 隰州黄河清。
units.en: In Xizhou the Yellow River ran clear—a portent.
units.literal: The Yellow River ran clear in Xi Prefecture.

units.zh: 於此書，見不為瑞也。
units.en: Its being recorded here shows that it was not treated as an auspicious omen.
units.literal: Recording it here shows that it was not taken as an auspicious omen.

units.zh: 九月，括马。
units.en: In the ninth month the court requisitioned horses.
units.literal: In the ninth month, horses were rounded up.

units.zh: 冬十月己未，講武于繁臺。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiwei, troops were reviewed at Fantai.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiwei, troops were reviewed at Fantai.

units.zh: 十一月壬寅，赦亡命背軍、髠黥刑徒。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the day renyin, fugitives, army deserters, and convicts marked by shaving and tattooing were pardoned.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, fugitives, those who had deserted the army, and convicts punished by shaving and tattooing were pardoned.

units.zh: 於好殺之世，小赦必書，見其亦有愛人之意也。
units.en: In an age fond of killing, even a minor pardon had to be recorded, showing that he too had some impulse to care for the people.
units.literal: In an age fond of killing, even a small pardon must be recorded, showing that he too had an intent to love the people.

units.zh: 二年春正月丁酉，渤海遣使者来。
units.en: In the first month of spring, second year, on the day dingyou, Bohai sent envoys.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, on the dingyou day of the second year, Bohai sent envoys.

units.zh: 己亥，卜郊于西都。
units.en: On the day jihai the court chose an auspicious day for the suburban rite at the western capital.
units.literal: On the jihai day, the suburban sacrifice was divined for at the western capital.

units.zh: 弑济阴王。
units.en: The Prince of Jiyin, the former Tang emperor, was murdered.
units.literal: The Prince of Jiyin was assassinated.

units.zh: 弒，臣子之大惡也，書濟陰王，從其實，書弒，正梁罪名。
units.en: Regicide is the great evil of subject and son. Calling him Prince of Jiyin follows the facts, and writing that he was murdered fixes Liang's crime by its proper name.
units.literal: Regicide is the great evil of ministers and sons; writing Prince of Jiyin follows the fact, and writing murdered corrects Liang's criminal name.

units.zh: 二月辛未， 契丹阿保机遣使者来。
units.en: In the second month, on the day xinwei, Khitan's Abaoji sent envoys.
units.literal: In the second month, on the xinwei day, Abaoji of the Khitan sent envoys.

units.zh: 三月壬申朔，如西都。
units.en: On the new moon of the third month, renshen, he traveled to the western capital.
units.literal: On the first day of the third month, renshen, he went to the western capital.

units.zh: 幸，已至也。
units.en: "Xing" means that he had already arrived.
units.literal: Xing means that he had already arrived.

units.zh: 如，往而未至之辭。
units.en: "Ru" is the term for going somewhere but not yet arriving.
units.literal: Ru is the term for going and not yet arriving.

units.zh: 有事，可以書。
units.en: "Performed rites" was an acceptable wording to record.
units.literal: Having rites performed can be written.

units.zh: 丙子，如怀州。
units.en: On the day bingzi he went to Huaizhou.
units.literal: On the bingzi day, he went to Huai Prefecture.

units.zh: 五代亂世，兵無虛日，不可悉書。
units.en: In the chaotic age of the Five Dynasties, hardly a day passed without warfare, and it could not all be recorded.
units.literal: In the disorderly age of the Five Dynasties, there was no empty day from war, and it could not all be written.

units.zh: 故用兵無勝敗，攻城無得失，皆不書。
units.en: Therefore troop deployments with no victory or defeat, and attacks on cities with no gain or loss, are not recorded.
units.literal: Therefore, troop use without victory or defeat and attacks on cities without gain or loss are all not recorded.

units.zh: 其命大將與天子有所如，自著大事爾。
units.en: The appointment of a great general, and places to which the Son of Heaven went, naturally mark major events.
units.literal: Appointments of great generals and places to which the Son of Heaven went naturally mark major events.

units.zh: 此如懷、澤者，以兵方攻潞州也。
units.en: This journey to Huai and Ze was because the armies were then attacking Luzhou.
units.literal: This going to Huai and Ze was because the armies were then attacking Luzhou.

units.zh: 丁丑，如泽州。
units.en: On the day dingchou he went to Zezhou.
units.literal: On the dingchou day, he went to Ze Prefecture.

units.zh: 戊寅，封鴻臚卿李崧萊國公，為二王後。
units.en: On the day wuyin Li Song, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, was made Duke of Lai and successor to the two royal houses.
units.literal: On wuyin, Li Song, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, was enfeoffed as Duke of Lai and made successor to the two royal houses.

units.zh: 梁嘗更「戊」曰「武」，而舊史悉復為「戊」。
units.en: Liang once changed the character "戊" to "武", but the old histories uniformly restored it as "戊".
units.literal: Liang once changed "戊" to "武", but the old histories all restored it as "戊".

units.zh: 壬午，匡国军节度使刘知俊为潞州行营招讨使。
units.en: On the day renwu Liu Zhijun, military governor of Kuangguo, was appointed to command the Lu Prefecture campaign.
units.literal: On the renwu day, Liu Zhijun, military governor of the Kuangguo army, was made commander-in-chief of the Lu Prefecture campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 癸巳，改卜郊。
units.en: On the day guisi the suburban rite was postponed and a new date set.
units.literal: On the guisi day, the suburban sacrifice was rescheduled.

units.zh: 张文蔚薨。
units.en: Zhang Wenwei died.
units.literal: Zhang Wenwei died.

units.zh: 夏四月癸卯，楊涉罷。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guimao, Yang She left office.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guimao, Yang She was dismissed.

units.zh: 吏部侍郎于兢為中書侍郎，翰林學士承旨禮部侍郎張策為刑部侍郎：同中書門下平章事。
units.en: Yu Jing, vice minister of Personnel, became vice director of the Secretariat (Zhongshu shilang), and Zhang Ce, Hanlin academician-in-attendance and vice minister of Rites, became vice minister of Justice; both held the rank of co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
units.literal: Yu Jing, vice minister of Personnel, became vice director of the Chancellery, and Zhang Ce, Hanlin academician-in-attendance and vice minister of Rites, became vice minister of Justice; both were co-equal managers of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 壬子，至澤州。
units.en: On the day renzi he arrived at Zezhou.
units.literal: On renzi, he arrived at Zezhou.

units.zh: 五月己丑，潞州行營都虞候康懷英及晉人戰于夾城，敗績。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, Kang Huaiying, chief defense officer of the Lu Prefecture campaign army, fought the Jin forces at Jiacheng and was defeated.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jichou, Kang Huaiying, chief defense officer of the Luzhou campaign army, fought the Jin forces at Jiacheng and was defeated.

units.zh: 築城圍潞，戰于城中，故書地。
units.en: Because he built fortifications to surround Lu and fought inside the city, the place is recorded.
units.literal: He built fortifications to surround Lu and fought inside the city, therefore the place is recorded.

units.zh: 戊戌，立唐三庙。
units.en: On the day wuxu the court founded shrines to three Tang emperors.
units.literal: On the wuxu day, the three temples of Tang were established.

units.zh: 契丹遣使者来。
units.en: The Khitan sent envoys.
units.literal: The Khitan sent envoys.

units.zh: 六月壬寅，忠武军节度使刘知俊为西路行营招讨使，以伐岐。
units.en: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, Liu Zhijun of Zhongwu was named commander of the western campaign against Qi.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the renyin day, Liu Zhijun, military governor of the Zhongwu army, was made commander-in-chief of the western-route campaign headquarters to attack Qi.

units.zh: 用兵之名有四：兩相攻曰攻，以大加小曰伐，加有罪曰討，天子自往曰征。
units.en: There are four terms for military action: when two sides attack one another it is called "attack"; when the great acts against the small it is "punitive expedition"; when punishing the guilty it is "to punish"; when the Son of Heaven goes in person it is "to campaign."
units.literal: There are four names for using troops: when two sides attack each other it is called attack; when the great is applied to the small it is called punitive expedition; when applied to the guilty it is called punishing; when the Son of Heaven goes himself it is called campaign.

units.zh: 隨事為文，不得不異，非有褒貶也。
units.en: The wording varies according to the event and cannot be otherwise; it does not imply praise or blame.
units.literal: The wording follows the event and cannot help being different; it does not contain praise or blame.

units.zh: 己酉， 杀右金吾卫上将军王师范，灭其族。
units.en: On the day jiyou Wang Shifan, senior general of the Right Golden Guard, was put to death and his entire clan wiped out.
units.literal: On the jiyou day, Wang Shifan, senior general of the Right Golden Guard, was executed and his clan exterminated.

units.zh: 當殺曰伏誅，不當殺者，以兩相殺為文。
units.en: When a killing was deserved, the text says "put to death"; when it was undeserved, it phrases the matter as mutual killing.
units.literal: When the killing is deserved, it says was put to death; when it was not deserved, it is phrased as two parties killing one another.

units.zh: 丙辰，刘知俊及岐人战于漠谷，败之。
units.en: On the day bingchen Liu Zhijun met the Qi army at Mogu and won.
units.literal: On the bingchen day, Liu Zhijun fought the Qi forces at Mogu and defeated them.

units.zh: 秋九月丁丑，如陝州，以晉人攻晉、絳故也。
units.en: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day dingchou, he went to Shanzhou because the Jin forces were attacking Jin and Jiang.
units.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on dingchou, he went to Shanzhou because the Jin forces were attacking Jin and Jiang.

units.zh: 博王友文留守東都。
units.en: Prince Youwen of Bo stayed behind to guard the eastern capital.
units.literal: Prince Youwen of Bo stayed behind to guard the eastern capital.

units.zh: 冬十月丁未，至自陕州。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingwei, he returned from Shanzhou.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the dingwei day, he returned from Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 十一月癸巳，张策罢，左僕射杨涉同中书门下平章事。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the day guisi, Zhang Ce was removed; Yang She, Left Vice Director, again became co-equal grand councilor.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the guisi day, Zhang Ce was dismissed, and Left Vice Director Yang She was made co-equal grand councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

units.zh: 十二月己亥，以介国公为三恪，酅国公、 莱国公为二王后。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on the day jihai, the Duke of Jie was named San Ke, highest ritual host to fallen thrones; the dukes of Xi and Lai tended the two exiled royal lines.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jihai day, the Duke of Jie was made San Ke; the Dukes of Xi and Lai were made custodians of the two former dynasties.

units.zh: 三年春正月甲戌，如西都。
units.en: In the first month of spring, third year, on the day jiaxu, he went to the western capital.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, on the jiaxu day of the third year, he went to the western capital.

units.zh: 復然燈以祈福。
units.en: Festival lamps were lit again to pray for blessings.
units.literal: Lamps were again lit in order to pray for blessings.

units.zh: 然燈，風俗相傳，自天子至于庶人，舉天下同其奢樂，而風俗敝之大者，故錄其詔意，則其失可知。
units.en: Lighting lamps was a transmitted custom; from the Son of Heaven down to commoners, the whole realm indulged in its extravagance and pleasure, a major corruption of custom. Recording the edict's intent therefore makes the fault clear.
units.literal: Lighting lamps was a custom transmitted by popular practice; from Son of Heaven down to commoners, the whole realm shared its extravagance and pleasure, and it was a great corruption of customs, so recording the intent of the edict makes its fault knowable.

units.zh: 庚寅，享于太庙。
units.en: On the day gengyin he sacrificed at the ancestral temple.
units.literal: On the gengyin day, he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 辛卯，有事于南郊，祀天于南郊，書曰有事，錄當時語。
units.en: On the day xinmao, he performed rites at the southern suburb; sacrificing to Heaven there is written as "performed rites" because the wording of the time is being recorded.
units.literal: On xinmao, rites were performed at the southern suburb; sacrificing to Heaven at the southern suburb is written as having business because it records the wording of the time.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was declared.
units.literal: There was a great amnesty.

units.zh: 丙申，群臣上尊号，曰睿文圣武广孝皇帝。
units.en: On the day bingshen the court offered him the honorific Sagely, Civil, Holy, Martial, and Broadly Filial Emperor.
units.literal: On the bingshen day, the officials presented a honorific title: Sagely, Civil, Holy, Martial, and Broadly Filial Emperor.

units.zh: 二月壬戌，讲武于西杏园。
units.en: In the second month, on the day renxu, troops were reviewed at the West Apricot Garden.
units.literal: In the second month, on the renxu day, a military review was held at West Apricot Garden.

units.zh: 甲子，延州高万兴叛于岐，来降。
units.en: On the day jiazi Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou broke with Qi and defected.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Gao Wanxing of Yan Prefecture rebelled against Qi and came to surrender.

units.zh: 唐末之亂，彊弱相并，或去彼來此，不可為常，難於遽責。
units.en: During the disorder at the end of Tang, strong and weak powers swallowed one another up, and some men left one side for another. This could not be treated as a fixed norm and was hard to condemn immediately.
units.literal: In the disorder at the end of Tang, strong and weak annexed one another, and some left that side and came to this one; it could not be made a constant rule and was hard to condemn at once.

units.zh: 至此乃書曰叛，始正其定分也。
units.en: Only here does the text write "rebelled," first setting the proper status distinction.
units.literal: Only here does the text write rebelled, first correcting the settled distinction.

units.zh: 三月辛未，渤海国王大諲譔遣使者来。
units.en: In the third month, on the day xinwei, Da Yinzhan, king of Bohai, sent envoys.
units.literal: In the third month, on the xinwei day, the king of Bohai, Da Yinzhan, sent envoys.

units.zh: 甲戌，如河中。
units.en: On the day jiaxu he went to Hezhong.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, he went to Hezhong.

units.zh: 以高萬興降，劉知俊兵攻鄜、延故也。
units.en: This was because Gao Wanxing had surrendered and Liu Zhijun's troops were attacking Fu and Yan.
units.literal: It was because Gao Wanxing surrendered and Liu Zhijun's troops attacked Fu and Yan.

units.zh: 山南东道节度使杨师厚为潞州四面行营招讨使。
units.en: Yang Shihou, military governor of Shannan East, was appointed to command all armies around Lu Prefecture.
units.literal: Yang Shihou, military governor of the Shannan East Circuit, was made commander-in-chief of the four-sided Lu Prefecture campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 刘知俊取丹州。
units.en: Liu Zhijun captured Danzhou.
units.literal: Liu Zhijun took Dan Prefecture.

units.zh: 夏四月丙午，知俊克延、鄜、坊三州。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the day bingwu, Zhijun seized Yan, Bin, and Fang.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the bingwu day, Zhijun took the three prefectures Yan, Bin, and Fang.

units.zh: 五月己卯，至自河中，杀佑国军节度使王重师。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, he returned from Hezhong and had Wang Chongshi, military governor of Youguo, executed.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the jimao day, he returned from Hezhong and executed Wang Chongshi, military governor of the Youguo army.

units.zh: 六月庚戌，刘知俊执佑国军节度使刘捍，叛附于岐。
units.en: In the sixth month, on the day gengxu, Liu Zhijun arrested Liu Han of Youguo, rebelled, and joined Qi.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengxu day, Liu Zhijun seized Liu Han, military governor of the Youguo army, rebelled, and went over to Qi.

units.zh: 以身歸曰降，以地歸曰附，亦文理宜然爾。
units.en: Returning with one's person is called surrendering; returning with territory is called attaching oneself. This too is proper to the logic of the wording.
units.literal: Returning with one's person is called surrendering; returning with territory is called attaching; this too is proper to the logic of the wording.

units.zh: 知俊為忠武軍節度使，以同州附岐，今直書知俊叛，而不言地，蓋忠武已見上文。
units.en: Zhijun was military governor of Zhongwu and attached Tongzhou to Qi; here the text simply says Zhijun rebelled and does not mention the territory, probably because Zhongwu has already appeared above.
units.literal: Zhijun was military governor of Zhongwu and attached Tongzhou to Qi; now the text directly writes that Zhijun rebelled and does not mention the territory, probably because Zhongwu has already appeared above.

units.zh: 辛亥，如陕州。
units.en: On the day xinhai he went to Shanzhou.
units.literal: On the xinhai day, he went to Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 以劉知俊叛故也。
units.en: This was because Liu Zhijun had rebelled.
units.literal: It was because Liu Zhijun rebelled.

units.zh: 乙卯， 冀王朱友谦为同州东面行营招讨使。
units.en: On the day yimao Zhu Youqian, Prince of Ji, was named commander of the eastern campaign against Tongzhou.
units.literal: On the yimao day, Zhu Youqian, Prince of Ji, was made commander-in-chief of the eastern-route Tong Prefecture campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 刘知俊奔于岐。
units.en: Liu Zhijun fled into Qi territory.
units.literal: Liu Zhijun fled to Qi.

units.zh: 丹州军乱，逐其刺史宋知诲。
units.en: The garrison at Danzhou mutinied and expelled Prefect Song Zhihui.
units.literal: The Dan Prefecture army mutinied and drove out its prefect Song Zhihui.

units.zh: 秋七月，商州军乱，逐其刺史李稠，稠奔于岐。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn the Shangzhou garrison mutinied, expelled Prefect Li Chou, and Chou fled to Qi.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Shang Prefecture army mutinied and drove out its prefect Li Chou; Chou fled to Qi.

units.zh: 乙丑，克丹州，执其首恶王行思。
units.en: On the day yichou Danzhou was recovered and the rebel leader Wang Xingsi taken.
units.literal: On the yichou day, Dan Prefecture was taken and its ringleader Wang Xingsi captured.

units.zh: 初不知首惡之人，故直曰軍亂，既克而推得之也。
units.en: At first the ringleader was not known, so the text simply says "the army mutinied"; only after the place was recovered was he identified.
units.literal: At first the chief evil person was not known, so it simply said the army mutinied; after it was recovered, he was investigated and found.

units.zh: 克丹州，無主將姓名，行思無官爵，又不見伏誅日，皆舊史失亡。
units.en: That Danzhou was recovered without naming the commanding general, that Xingsi has no office or title, and that the date of his execution is not shown are all losses in the old history.
units.literal: For the recovery of Danzhou, there is no commanding general's name; Xingsi has no office or title, and the day he was put to death is also not seen: all are losses in the old history.

units.zh: 乙亥，至自陕州。
units.en: On the day yihai he returned from Shanzhou.
units.literal: On the yihai day, he returned from Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 甲申，襄州軍亂，殺其留後王班。
units.en: On the day jiashen the Xiangzhou garrison mutinied and killed Acting Governor Wang Ban.
units.literal: On jiashen, the Xiangzhou army mutinied and killed its acting governor Wang Ban.

units.zh: 智不足以衞身，才不足以治眾而見殺，不書死之，而以被殺為文，見死得其死者，士之大節，不妄以予人。
units.en: His judgment was insufficient to protect himself and his ability insufficient to govern the troops, and so he was killed. The text does not write that he "died for it," but phrases it as "was killed," showing that dying a worthy death is a great principle for a gentleman and is not lightly granted to anyone.
units.literal: His wisdom was not enough to protect himself and his talent not enough to govern the multitude, and he was killed; the text does not write died for it, but phrases it as was killed, showing that dying the death one should is a great principle for a gentleman and is not rashly granted to people.

units.zh: 房州刺史杨虔叛附于蜀。
units.en: Fangzhou Prefect Yang Qian rebelled and defected to Shu.
units.literal: Yang Qian, prefect of Fang Prefecture, rebelled and went over to Shu.

units.zh: 八月辛亥，降死罪囚。
units.en: In the eighth month, on the day xinhai, prisoners sentenced to death were reprieved.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the xinhai day, death sentences were commuted.

units.zh: 辛酉，均州刺史张敬方克房州，执杨虔。
units.en: On the day xinyou Junzhou Prefect Zhang Jingfang retook Fangzhou and seized Yang Qian.
units.literal: On the xinyou day, Zhang Jingfang, prefect of Jun Prefecture, took Fang Prefecture and captured Yang Qian.

units.zh: 閏月癸酉，契丹遣使者來。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on the day guiyou, the Khitan sent envoys.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the guiyou day, the Khitan sent envoys.

units.zh: 己卯，閱稼于西苑。
units.en: On the day jimao he inspected the harvest in the western park.
units.literal: On the jimao day, the crops were inspected in the western park.

units.zh: 九月壬寅，行營招討使左衞上將軍陳暉克襄州，執其首惡李洪。
units.en: In the ninth month, on the day renyin, Chen Hui, campaign commander of the Left Guard, recovered Xiangzhou and seized the rebel Li Hong.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the renyin day, Chen Hui, campaign commander and senior general of the Left Guard, took Xiang Prefecture and captured the ringleader Li Hong.

units.zh: 命暉討亂，舊史失不書，至此始見。
units.en: Hui had been ordered to suppress the disorder, but the old history failed to record it; only here does it first appear.
units.literal: Hui was ordered to suppress the disorder, but the old history missed it and did not record it; only here does it first appear.

units.zh: 既克而推得其首惡，故初亦且書軍亂。
units.en: After the city was recovered, the ringleader was identified, so at first the text merely records a military mutiny.
units.literal: After it was recovered, the chief evil man was investigated and found, so at first it too merely records an army mutiny.

units.zh: 丁未，保义军节度使王檀为潞州东面行营招讨使。
units.en: On the day dingwei Wang Tan of Baoyi was appointed to command the eastern Lu Prefecture campaign.
units.literal: On the dingwei day, Wang Tan, military governor of the Baoyi army, was made commander-in-chief of the eastern-route Lu Prefecture campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 辛亥，韩建、杨涉罢。
units.en: On the day xinhai Han Jian and Yang She left office.
units.literal: On the xinhai day, Han Jian and Yang She were dismissed.

units.zh: 太常卿赵光逢为中书侍郎、翰林学士承旨工部侍郎杜晓为户部侍郎：同中书门下平章事。
units.en: Zhao Guangfeng, Director of Ceremonies, and Du Xiao of the Hanlin became vice chancellors and co-equal grand councilors.
units.literal: Director of Ceremonies Zhao Guangfeng was made vice director of the Chancellery, and Du Xiao, academician expositor of the Hanlin and vice director of Works, was made vice director of Revenue: co-equal grand councilors of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

units.zh: 辛酉，李洪、杨虔伏诛。
units.en: On the day xinyou Li Hong and Yang Qian were executed.
units.literal: On the xinyou day, Li Hong and Yang Qian were executed.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲午，日南至，告谢于南郊。
units.en: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day jiawu—the winter solstice—thanksgiving rites were held at the southern altar.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, the winter solstice; thanksgiving rites were performed at the southern suburb.

units.zh: 南至不必書，因其以至日告謝而書。
units.en: The winter solstice did not have to be recorded; it is recorded because he used the solstice day to offer thanks.
units.literal: The southern solstice need not be recorded; because he used the solstice day to offer thanks, it is recorded.

units.zh: 告謝主用至日，故書之。
units.en: The thanksgiving rite chiefly used the solstice day, so it is recorded.
units.literal: The thanksgiving chiefly used the solstice day, therefore it is recorded.

units.zh: 不曰有事于南郊，亦從其本語。
units.en: That the text does not say "performed rites at the southern suburb" also follows the original wording.
units.literal: Not saying that rites were performed at the southern suburb also follows its original wording.

units.zh: 蓋比南郊禮差簡。
units.en: It was probably somewhat simpler than the full southern-suburb rite.
units.literal: It was probably somewhat simpler than the southern-suburb rite.

units.zh: 己酉，搜訪賢良。
units.en: On the day jiyou the court called for worthy men to serve.
units.literal: On jiyou, worthy and good men were sought out.

units.zh: 镇国军节度使康怀英伐岐。
units.en: Kang Huaiying, military governor of Zhenguo, marched against Qi.
units.literal: Kang Huaiying, military governor of the Zhenguo army, attacked Qi.

units.zh: 十二月，怀英克宁、庆、衍三州。
units.en: In the twelfth month Huaiying captured Ning, Qing, and Yan.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Huaiying took the three prefectures Ning, Qing, and Yan.

units.zh: 及刘知俊战于升平，败绩。
units.en: At Shengping he met Liu Zhijun and was routed.
units.literal: He fought Liu Zhijun at Shengping and was defeated.

units.zh: 四年春正月壬辰朔，始用乐。
units.en: In the first month of spring, fourth year, on the new moon renchen, court music was performed for the first time.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, on the renchen new moon of the fourth year, music was first used.

units.zh: 自唐末之亂，禮樂亡，至此始用樂，故書。
units.en: Since the disorder at the end of Tang, rites and music had fallen away; music was first used again here, so the event is recorded.
units.literal: Since the disorder at the end of Tang, rites and music had perished; only at this point was music first used, so it is recorded.

units.zh: 丁未，讲武于榆林。
units.en: On the day dingwei troops were reviewed at Yulin.
units.literal: On the dingwei day, a military review was held at Yulin.

units.zh: 二月己丑，閱稼于穀水。
units.en: In the second month, on the day jichou, the harvest was inspected at Gushui.
units.literal: In the second month, on the jichou day, the crops were inspected at Gushui.

units.zh: 秋八月丙寅，如陕州。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day bingyin, he went to Shanzhou.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the bingyin day, he went to Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 以岐人、晉人攻夏州故也。
units.en: This was because the Qi and Jin forces were attacking Xiazhou.
units.literal: It was because the Qi and Jin forces were attacking Xiazhou.

units.zh: 河南尹张宗奭留守西都。
units.en: Zhang Zongshi, prefect of Henan, stayed behind to guard the western capital.
units.literal: Zhang Zongshi, prefect of Henan, remained to guard the western capital.

units.zh: 辛未，护国军节度使杨师厚为西路行营招讨使以伐岐。
units.en: On the day xinwei Yang Shihou of Huguo was named commander of the western campaign against Qi.
units.literal: On the xinwei day, Yang Shihou, military governor of the Huguo army, was made commander-in-chief of the western-route campaign headquarters to attack Qi.

units.zh: 九月己丑，至自陕州。
units.en: In the ninth month, on the day jichou, he returned from Shanzhou.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the jichou day, he returned from Shan Prefecture.

units.zh: 辛亥，搜訪賢良。
units.en: On the day xinhai the court again called for worthy men.
units.literal: On the xinhai day, worthy and good men were sought.

units.zh: 冬十一月己丑， 宁国军节度使王景仁为北面行营招讨使以伐赵。
units.en: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day jichou, Wang Jingren of Ningguo was appointed to command the northern campaign against Zhao.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the jichou day, Wang Jingren, military governor of the Ningguo army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters to attack Zhao.

units.zh: 趙王王鎔、北平王王處直叛附于晉，晉人救趙。
units.en: Wang Rong of Zhao and Wang Chuzhi of Beiping rebelled and sided with Jin; the Jin army marched to Zhao's aid.
units.literal: The Zhao prince Wang Rong and the Beiping prince Wang Chuzhi rebelled and went over to Jin; the Jin forces came to rescue Zhao.

units.zh: 十二月癸酉，頒律令格式。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on the day guiyou, the new code of laws and administrative formats was issued.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the guiyou day, the statutes, ordinances, and formats were promulgated.

units.zh: 乾化元年春正月丁亥，王景仁及晉人戰于柏鄉，敗績。
units.en: In the first month of spring, Qianhua 1 (911), on the day dinghai, Wang Jingren met the Jin at Baixiang and lost.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, on the dinghai day of the first year of Qianhua, Wang Jingren fought the Jin forces at Baixiang and was defeated.

units.zh: 庚寅，赦流罪以下囚， 求危言正谏。
units.en: On the day gengyin the court pardoned exiles and lesser offenders and called for frank remonstrance.
units.literal: On the gengyin day, exiles convicted of banishment and lesser crimes were pardoned, and blunt counsel was sought.

units.zh: 癸巳，天雄军节度使杨师厚为北面行营招讨使。
units.en: On the day guisi Yang Shihou, military governor of Tianxiong, was appointed to command the northern campaign.
units.literal: On the guisi day, Yang Shihou, military governor of the Tianxiong army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申，契丹阿保机遣使者来。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the day renshen, Khitan's Abaoji sent envoys.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the renshen day, Abaoji of the Khitan sent envoys.

units.zh: 五月甲申朔，大赦，改元。
units.en: On the new moon of the fifth month, jiashen, he declared a general amnesty and adopted a new reign title.
units.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, jiashen, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

units.zh: 癸巳，幸张宗奭第。
units.en: On the day guisi he paid a visit to Zhang Zongshi's mansion.
units.literal: On the guisi day, he visited the residence of Zhang Zongshi.

units.zh: 秋八月戊辰， 阅稼于榆林。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day wuchen, he inspected the harvest at Yulin.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the wuchen day, the crops were inspected at Yulin.

units.zh: 渤海遣使者来。
units.en: Bohai sent envoys.
units.literal: Bohai sent envoys.

units.zh: 戊寅，大閱于興安鞠場。
units.en: On the day wuyin troops were reviewed at the Xing'an ball grounds.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, a great military review was held at the Xing'an cuju grounds.

units.zh: 九月辛巳朔，御文明殿，入閤。
units.en: On the new moon of the ninth month, xinsi, he held court in the Hall of Civilization and received ministers in the inner chamber.
units.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, xinsi, he held court in the Hall of Civilization and entered the inner audience.

units.zh: 御殿而云入閤，錄其本語。
units.en: To say "entered the cabinet" while he was in fact holding court in a palace records the original wording.
units.literal: Holding court in the hall but saying entered the cabinet records the original wording.

units.zh: 事在李琪列傳。
units.en: The matter appears in Li Qi's biography.
units.literal: The matter is in Li Qi's biography.

units.zh: 此禮，其後屢行，皆不書，一書以見其失足矣。
units.en: This ceremony was repeated many times afterward, but none of those instances are recorded; recording it once shows the impropriety of the step.
units.literal: This ceremony was often performed afterward, but none are recorded; recording it once shows its misstep.

units.zh: 庚子，如魏州。
units.en: On the day gengzi he went to Weizhou.
units.literal: On the gengzi day, he went to Weizhou.

units.zh: 以晉人攻魏故也。
units.en: This was because the Jin forces were attacking Wei.
units.literal: It was because the Jin forces were attacking Wei.

units.zh: 张宗奭留守西都。
units.en: Zhang Zongshi stayed behind to guard the western capital.
units.literal: Zhang Zongshi remained to guard the western capital.

units.zh: 冬十月丙子，大阅于魏东郊。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingzi, troops were reviewed east of Weizhou.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the bingzi day, a great military review was held east of Weizhou.

units.zh: 十一月， 高万兴取盐州。
units.en: In the eleventh month Gao Wanxing captured Salt Prefecture.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Gao Wanxing took Salt Prefecture.

units.zh: 壬辰，至自魏州。
units.en: On the day renchen he returned from Weizhou.
units.literal: On the renchen day, he returned from Weizhou.

units.zh: 乙未，回鶻、吐蕃遣使者來。
units.en: On the day yiwei the Uyghurs and Tibetans sent envoys.
units.literal: On yiwei, the Uyghurs and Tibetans sent envoys.

units.zh: 二年春二月丁巳，光祿卿盧玭使于蜀。
units.en: In the second month of spring, second year, on the day dingsi, Lu Pin, Chamberlain for Ceremonials, was dispatched to Shu as envoy.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, second month, on dingsi, Chamberlain for Ceremonials Lu Pin was sent as envoy to Shu.

units.zh: 甲子，如魏州，亦以晉人及鎮、定攻相、魏也。
units.en: On the day jiazi he went to Weizhou, also because Jin and the forces of Zhen and Ding were attacking Xiang and Wei.
units.literal: On jiazi, he went to Weizhou, also because the Jin forces and Zhen and Ding were attacking Xiang and Wei.

units.zh: 張宗奭留守西都。
units.en: Zhang Zongshi stayed behind to guard the western capital.
units.literal: Zhang Zongshi stayed behind to guard the western capital.

units.zh: 次白馬，殺左散騎常侍孫騭、右諫議大夫張衍、兵部郎中張儁。
units.en: At Baima he had Sun Zhi, Left Regular Attendant, Zhang Yan, Right Remonstrance Officer, and Zhang Jun of the Ministry of War put to death.
units.literal: Stopping at Baima, he killed Sun Zhi, Left Regular Attendant, Zhang Yan, Right Remonstrance Grand Master, and Zhang Jun, Gentleman of the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 戊寅，如貝州。
units.en: On the day wuyin he went to Beizhou.
units.literal: On wuyin, he went to Beizhou.

units.zh: 三月丙戌，屠棗彊。
units.en: In the third month, on the day bingxu, Zaoqiang was sacked and its people slaughtered.
units.literal: In the third month, on bingxu, he slaughtered Zaoqiang.

units.zh: 丁未，复如魏州。
units.en: On the day dingwei he went to Weizhou again.
units.literal: On the dingwei day, he again went to Weizhou.

units.zh: 夏四月己巳，至自魏州。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jisi, he returned from Weizhou.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the jisi day, he returned from Weizhou.

units.zh: 下書「如西都」，則此至東都可知。
units.en: Since the later text says "went to the western capital," this arrival at the eastern capital can be inferred.
units.literal: Below it writes went to the western capital, so this arrival at the eastern capital can be known.

units.zh: 戊寅，如西都。
units.en: On the day wuyin he went to the western capital.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, he went to the western capital.

units.zh: 五月丁亥，德音降死罪已下囚。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the day dinghai, a mercy edict reprieved prisoners sentenced to death and below.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, an edict of grace commuted the sentences of prisoners down to and including those condemned to death.

units.zh: 「德音」，赦之小者。
units.en: A "gracious decree" is a lesser form of amnesty.
units.literal: A gracious pronouncement is the lesser kind of pardon.

units.zh: 從其本名，以著其實。
units.en: The text follows its original name to show what it actually was.
units.literal: It follows its original name in order to show its reality.

units.zh: 罢役徒，禁屠及捕生。
units.en: Forced laborers were dismissed, and slaughter and hunting were banned.
units.literal: Corvée laborers were released; slaughter and the taking of living creatures were forbidden.

units.zh: 渤海遣使者来。
units.en: Bohai sent envoys.
units.literal: Bohai sent envoys.

units.zh: 是月，薛貽矩薨。
units.en: That month Xue Yiju died.
units.literal: That month, Xue Yiju died.

units.zh: 六月，疾革， 郢王友珪反。
units.en: In the sixth month, as his illness worsened, Prince of Ying Yougui rose in rebellion.
units.literal: In the sixth month, his illness turned critical and Prince of Ying Yougui rebelled.

units.zh: 戊寅，皇帝崩。
units.en: On the day wuyin the emperor died.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, the emperor died.

units.zh: 年六十一。
units.en: He was sixty-one years old.
units.literal: He was sixty-one years old.

units.zh: 不書崩處，以異於得其終者。
units.en: The place of his death is not recorded, distinguishing him from those who met a proper end.
units.literal: The place where he died is not recorded, to distinguish him from those who reached their proper end.

units.zh: 乾化二年十一月，友珪葬之河南伊闕縣，號宣陵。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Qianhua 2, Yougui buried him in Yique County, Henan, and named the tomb Xuanling.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of Qianhua 2, Yougui buried him in Yique County, Henan, naming it Xuanling.

units.zh: 以不得其死，故不書葬。
units.en: Because he did not die a proper death, the text does not record his burial.
units.literal: Because he did not die his proper death, burial is therefore not recorded.

units.zh: 嗚呼，天下之惡梁久矣！
units.en: Alas—the world has hated Liang for ages!
units.literal: Alas, the world has long hated Liang!

units.zh: 自後唐以來，皆以為偽也。
units.en: Since the Later Tang, every court has treated Liang as a usurper's regime.
units.literal: Since Later Tang, all have held it illegitimate.

units.zh: 至予論次五代，獨不偽梁，而議者或譏予大失春秋之旨，以謂：「梁負大惡，當加誅絕，而反進之，是奬篡也，非春秋之志也。」
units.en: When I set the Five Dynasties in order, I alone refused to brand Liang illegitimate. Some reproached me for betraying the Spring and Autumn Annals: "Liang committed crimes too great to name; you should erase it from the succession, not enshrine it. That is to reward usurpation—not what the Spring and Autumn intended."
units.literal: When I arranged the Five Dynasties, I alone did not treat Liang as illegitimate, and critics said I had gravely missed the aim of the Spring and Autumn Annals, saying, "Liang bore the greatest guilt and ought to be utterly condemned, yet you advance it instead—this rewards usurpation and is not the intent of the Spring and Autumn."

units.zh: 予应之曰：「是《春秋》之志尔。
units.en: I answered: "On the contrary—that is precisely what the Spring and Autumn intended.
units.literal: I answered: "That is precisely the intent of the Spring and Autumn.

units.zh: 鲁桓公弑隐公而自立者，宣公弑子赤而自立者，郑厉公逐世子忽而自立者，卫公孙剽逐其君衎而自立者，圣人于《春秋》，皆不绝其为君。
units.en: Duke Huan of Lu murdered Duke Yin and took the throne; Duke Xuan murdered Prince Chi and took the throne; Duke Li of Zheng expelled the crown prince Hu and took the throne; Gongsun Piao of Wei drove out his lord Kuan and took the throne—yet in the Spring and Autumn the Sage never struck their titles as rulers.
units.literal: Duke Huan of Lu, who murdered Duke Yin and established himself; Duke Xuan, who murdered Prince Chi and established himself; Duke Li of Zheng, who drove out the crown prince Hu and established himself; and Gongsun Piao of Wei, who drove out his lord Kuan and established himself—in the Spring and Autumn the Sage did not cut off their status as rulers for any of them.

units.zh: 此予所以不伪梁者，用《春秋》 之法也。」
units.en: That is why I will not brand Liang illegitimate: I follow the Spring and Autumn's method."
units.literal: This is why I do not treat Liang as illegitimate: I use the method of the Spring and Autumn."

units.zh: 「然則春秋亦奬篡乎？」
units.en: "Then does the Spring and Autumn reward usurpation after all?"
units.literal: "Then does the Spring and Autumn also reward usurpation?"

units.zh: 曰：「惟不绝四者之为君，于此见《春秋》之意也。
units.en: The answer: "Only by refusing to strike their titles do you see what the Spring and Autumn truly means.
units.literal: He said: "Only in not cutting off these four as rulers does one see the meaning of the Spring and Autumn.

units.zh: 圣人之于《春秋》，用意深，故能劝戒切，为言信，然后善恶明。
units.en: In the Spring and Autumn the Sage's purpose runs deep—deep enough to admonish with force, truthful enough that good and evil stand plain.
units.literal: In the Spring and Autumn the Sage's intent runs deep; thus his admonitions are sharp, his words carry truth, and only then are good and evil clear.

units.zh: 夫欲著其罪于后世，在乎不没其实。
units.en: If you mean to expose a man's guilt to later ages, you must not erase what he actually did.
units.literal: To fix guilt upon posterity depends on not erasing what actually happened.

units.zh: 其实尝为君矣，书其为君。
units.en: If he truly ruled, write him down as a ruler.
units.literal: If the fact is that he was once a ruler, record him as a ruler.

units.zh: 其实篡也，书其篡。
units.en: If the truth is usurpation, write the usurpation.
units.literal: If the fact is usurpation, record the usurpation.

units.zh: 各传其实，而使后世信之，则四君之罪，不可得而掩尔。
units.en: Record each fact faithfully so posterity will believe it; then the four rulers' crimes cannot be buried.
units.literal: Each fact transmitted as it was, so that posterity believes—and then the guilt of the four rulers cannot be hidden.

units.zh: 使为君者不得掩其恶，然后人知恶名不可逃，则为恶者庶乎其息矣。
units.en: Let no ruler hide his wickedness. Then men learn that infamy offers no escape—and perhaps the wicked will think twice.
units.literal: Let rulers be unable to hide their wickedness; then people know an evil name cannot be escaped, and those who would do evil may perhaps cease.

units.zh: 是谓用意深而劝戒切，为言信而善恶明也。
units.en: That is what it means for the intent to run deep and the warning to bite, for the words to be true and good and evil to stand clear.
units.literal: This is what is meant by deep intent and sharp admonition, truthful speech and clear good and evil.

units.zh: 桀、纣，不待贬其王，而万世所共恶者也。
units.en: Jie and Zhou needed no demotion from kingship—the ages have condemned them of themselves.
units.literal: Jie and Zhou—without needing to strip them of kingship, are hated alike by ten thousand ages.

units.zh: 《春秋》于大恶之君不诛绝之者，不害其褒善贬恶之旨也，惟不没其实以著其罪，而信乎后世，与其为君而不得掩其恶，以息人之为恶。
units.en: When the Spring and Autumn spares even a ruler of great evil from utter erasure, it does not abandon praise of virtue and condemnation of vice. It only refuses to falsify the record so guilt may stand before posterity—so that, recorded as rulers, they cannot hide their crimes, and men may cease from evil.
units.literal: In the Spring and Autumn, for rulers of great evil whom it does not utterly condemn—this does not harm its purpose of praising good and condemning evil; it only refuses to erase the fact so as to fix their guilt, so that posterity believes, and with their status as rulers they cannot hide their wickedness, putting an end to people's doing evil.

units.zh: 能知《春秋》之此意，然后知予不伪梁之旨也。」
units.en: Understand this intent of the Spring and Autumn, and you will understand why I refuse to brand Liang illegitimate."
units.literal: Only one who understands this meaning of the Spring and Autumn can understand my purpose in not treating Liang as illegitimate."
